facts.statement: The genus Luoyanggia was described by Lü et al. in 2009.
The type species of the genus is Luoyanggia liudianensis.
Luoyanggia is a genus of oviraptorid dinosaur named after the city of Luoyang.
facts.quote: Luoyanggia (meaning "from Luoyang") is a genus of oviraptorid dinosaur

facts.statement: Fossils of Luoyanggia come from the Early Cretaceous Haoling Formation in the Ruyang Basin of Henan Province, central China.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous Haoling Formation of the Ruyang Basin in Henan Province, central China

facts.statement: Holtz estimated Luoyanggia to be about 1.5 meters long and weigh between 2.27 and 9.1 kilograms.
facts.quote: Holtz estimated it at 1.5 m and around 2.27 - 9.1 kg

facts.statement: Molina-Pérez and Larramendi estimated the size of Luoyanggia to be 1.2 meters long and 8.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: Molina-Pérez and Larramendi gave a similar size of 1.2 m and 8.5 kg

facts.statement: Fieldwork and fossil assemblages indicate that the Haoling Formation, where Luoyanggia was found, dates to the Aptian-Albian stages.
facts.quote: extensive fieldwork in the Ruyang Basin and invertebrate and microfossil assemblages indicate an Aptian-Albian age for the Haoling Formation

facts.statement: Luoyanggia belongs to the family Oviraptoridae.
Luoyanggia lived between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Albian (121.4 to 100.5 million years ago)
